name: Pilgrimage
overview: Scripture presents pilgrimage as a meaningful journey rooted in faith and devotion to God, exemplified by the annual trips to Jerusalem for the Passover (Luke 2:41). Believers are encouraged to seek the 'old paths' of righteousness for true rest of soul (Jeremiah 6:16) and to place their strength in the Lord, whose power renews and sustains them (Psalms 84:5; Isaiah 40:31). This pilgrimage ultimately points to worshiping Christ, who is the source of eternal life offered to all who believe (Matthew 28:17; John 3:16).
